name: @intellectual-frontiers/githost
description: The Git hosts behind one typed interface: GitHub (public and private repositories), GitLab (groups to any depth, gitlab.com or self-managed) and plain Git, held to the same conformance tests, and the reading of a remote in any form a person writes it; the same code on Bun and Node 26.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
